evals.expected_output: Should parse two separate KR updates from a single Chinese sentence: (1) KR3 progress(kr3): tagging accuracy acc=92%/95%, and (2) KR2 progress(kr2): editing grade=C-/C. Should create two separate commits on correct KR branches (checkout, commit, checkout main). Should show progress deltas for both KRs.

Should display a terminal dashboard showing all KRs with current progress computed from git log. Should include health markers and blocked items. Should handle grade and milestone metrics correctly. Should suggest next actions for at-risk or blocked items. Dashboard is NEVER written to file.

Should modify okr.md on main branch: update KR1 target to launch+500DAU and weight to 35%. Should commit with format revise(kr1): target changed to launch+500DAU, weight to 35%. Should NOT touch any KR branch. Should show updated spec preview.
MUST NOT silently pick a KR. Multiple KRs may involve accuracy/precision. Should list candidate KRs with aliases and ask user to choose. Safety gate: ambiguous input = hard interrupt, never guess.

Should commit with project scope: done(kr1/user-seg): model training complete. Commit goes on kr1 branch. Metro should render a sub-track (thin line) branching from kr1 trunk with a diamond (done) dot merging back.

Should create ~/.okr as git repo (if not exists). Generate okr.md on main with spec-only format. Create KR branches (YYYY Q2/kr/N-slug). NO worktrees created. Copy metro template to ~/.okr/bin/metro. Commit: init: okr tracking YYYYQ2. Show git graph.

Should run final status derivation and present scores. Commit on main: close: Q1 2026 final O1=X% O2=Y%. Create tag: git tag -a v2026-Q1. Should NOT merge KR branches. Should NOT delete branches. Branches are history, not features.

Should run ~/.okr/bin/metro to generate metro.html. Output should contain exactly 3 dot shapes: circle (progress), diamond (done), square (blocked). Legend should show 3 event types + line weight distinction (trunk vs scope). No fix/review/note dots.
